description: This file contains functions for handling file and stream responses in an HTTP server, including setting appropriate headers based on content type and download preferences.

methods.name: WriteFileResponse
methods.description: Copies a file represented by io.ReadSeeker to the HTTP response, setting headers appropriately.

methods.name: WriteStreamResponse
methods.description: Streams data from an io.Reader to the HTTP response, setting headers appropriately.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets HTTP headers for content type, caching, content disposition, and security options based on parameters.
